children.content: Every SF Symbol that could mean ask the agent: large, and as it sits in the 28 px spark. Medium weight, the app's accent colour.
A small spark sits on the selection's top-right corner. Click it or press ⌘↩ to ask about exactly what is selected. Nothing else on the canvas changes.
Everything in Free, plus unlimited decks and offline mode.

children.name: 2. Ask: a composer on the selection

children.content: The composer opens beside the selection, never over it. The chip says what the agent will see; the harness is your own Claude Code or Codex. Return sends.
Everything in Free, plus unlimited decks and offline mode.
Make it calmer: more air, a softer shadow, a quieter price.▏

children.name: 3. Work: one quiet line while the canvas changes

children.content: The canvas shows the work. The composer only says what it is doing right now, in one line, with Stop. The run is one step in your undo history.
Everything in Free, plus unlimited decks and offline mode.
Make it calmer: more air, a softer shadow, a quieter…

children.name: 4. Done: keep it or undo it

children.content: One line says what changed. Keep closes the composer; Undo takes the whole run back in one step; a follow-up continues the conversation.
Everything in Free, plus unlimited decks and offline mode.

children.name: 5. Closed while working: the run goes on

children.content: Escape closes the composer, not the run. The spark becomes a progress ring on the layer, then a dot when the run ends and the canvas glosses what changed.
Everything in Free, plus unlimited decks and offline mode.

children.name: 6. Back later: the thread lives on the layer

children.content: A layer that has been asked about shows a dot on its spark. Select it again, open the spark, and the same conversation is there, so a follow-up knows what it means.
Everything in Free, plus unlimited decks and offline mode.
Make it calmer: more air, a softer shadow, a quieter price.
A bit less padding than that▏

After Stitch and Replit: the selection sits in the field as a removable chip; the harness in mono.
After Gemini: a single 36 pt line that changes in place.
After Base44: ask from the layer's own toolbar, next to copy and delete.
After Recraft and Visual Electric: one spot for every ask, the selection as a chip.
A plain field with a quiet mono strip: place, harness, progress, time.
Picked 2026-11-16. The spark grows into a Liquid Glass pill; counts in mono; a mono chip when several layers are selected.

Six takes on talking to the selection, each empty, typing three lines, and after two exchanges. Send and the harness mark sit on the last line or in a bottom toolbar. The spark beside each one is unchanged.
After Cursor, LangChain and Plane. The field on top; the harness as a picker label left, send right, in one toolbar row.
Why is send button not aligned in these designs? It should sit on the last line with the Claude mark, never centred against the field.
children.name: Field

children.content: Why is send button not aligned in these designs?
The field had a fixed width, so Send floated mid-row. It fills the row now, and Send sits on the last line.
Do the same in the dark row
